title: Verify indexed-context getter range overlap
changes: Compare the original indexed-context getter for all byte indices conditionally addressing the bounded-range owner, adjacent indices and high-byte aliases.
validation: Windows GNU build bounded-range-context-overlap-build-mcl2h3ml and Wine bounded-range-context-overlap-wine-3lrpx1l2 pass 96 complete-state/clock comparisons with all 88 range bytes altered: 88 in-range cases each serve one range byte and eight adjacent cases serve none. Interpreter and generated dispatch run; protected inputs pass, scratch removed and Wine drains.
limitations: Controlled indices do not establish ordinary reachability or other callers; generated blocks may fall back to interpretation. Other computed consumers, production cache selection, legacy IRQ equivalence, broader regressions, Linux, USA, native Windows and performance remain open.
